items.prompt: Take a good look: Which group of words is a complete sentence?  (in this lesson: Sentence or Not?)
items.explanation: 'The stars twinkle.' names the stars and what they do, so it is a complete sentence.

items.prompt: What do you think? Which group of words is NOT a complete sentence?  (in this lesson: Sentence or Not?)
items.explanation: 'beside the window' names a place but no doer or action, so it is not a complete sentence.

items.prompt: What is missing from 'dark and cold'?

options.text: who or what is doing the action

items.explanation: 'dark and cold' is missing who or what is doing the action, so it does not tell a complete idea.

items.prompt: Take a good look: Which group of words tells a complete idea?  (in this lesson: Sentence or Not?)
items.explanation: 'Tito John fixes the car.' has a doer and an action, so it tells a complete idea.

items.prompt: What do you think? Which is a complete sentence?  (in this lesson: Sentence or Not?)
items.explanation: 'Maxine reads a book.' names who and what they do, so it is a complete sentence.
